Andy’s Custard Menu: From Classic to Creative – What’s New and Delicious

When it comes to frozen treats, few places do it as well as Andy’s Frozen Custard. With a variety of flavors, toppings, and creative combinations, Andy’s offers an extensive frozen custard menu that satisfies every sweet craving. Whether you’re a fan of the classic vanilla or chocolate frozen custard or you’re looking for something more adventurous, Andy’s menu items will surely hit the spot. This post delves deep into Andy’s frozen custard menu, including a detailed breakdown of prices, delicious toppings, sundaes, concretes, and much more.

The Essence of Frozen Custard at Andy’s

Andy’s Frozen Custard offers a rich and creamy dessert experience with their frozen custard made from high-quality ingredients. Unlike ice cream, frozen custard is smoother, denser, and creamier, making it a favorite among many. The key difference is the inclusion of egg yolks in the mixture, which creates a rich texture and deep flavor that keeps customers coming back for more.

Whether you’re in the mood for a classic treat or something creative, Andy’s offers a full menu of frozen custard options that will meet your desires. From cones to pints and quarts, there’s a frozen custard treat for everyone. You can also opt for seasonal creations or try one of their specialty combinations.

Menu Items at Andy’s Frozen Custard

The frozen custard menu at Andy’s offers a range of options designed to cater to all preferences. Here are some of the most popular menu items:

Frozen Custard Cones

For a simple yet satisfying experience, try Andy’s vanilla or chocolate frozen custard served in a cone. Choose from the classic cone, or go for a topping like hot fudge, pecans, or cherry for an added treat. Here’s a breakdown of the pricing for these cones:

Item Price
Vanilla or Chocolate Cone $3.99
Vanilla or Chocolate with Topping $4.49

Sundaes and Concretes

Sundaes and concretes are a staple at Andy’s, featuring a generous serving of frozen custard topped with a variety of goodies. The famous banana split and brownie sundae are two of the most requested. Let’s take a look at the sundae and concrete prices:

Item Price
Brownie Sundae $5.99
Fudge Sundae $6.49
Banana Split $6.99
Triple Chocolate Concrete $7.49

Pick 6 Creations

The Pick 6 allows you to select six toppings to create your perfect concrete. Whether it’s peanut butter, hot fudge, or crème caramel, you can customize your creation for the ultimate frozen custard experience.

Item Price
Pick 6 Concrete $7.99

Pints and Quarts

For those who want to take their frozen custard experience home, Andy’s offers pints and quarts filled with your favorite flavors. These are perfect for sharing (or not!). Pricing for the pints and quarts is as follows:

Item Price
Pint (Vanilla or Chocolate) $4.99
Quart (Vanilla or Chocolate) $8.99
Seasonal Flavored Quart $9.49

Seasonal Flavors

Each season brings something new to the menu. From strawberry in the spring to pumpkin in the fall, Andy’s offers seasonal flavors that change regularly. These limited-time flavors can be enjoyed as part of any creation.

Item Price
Seasonal Flavor Cone $4.99
Seasonal Flavor Sundae $5.99

Creative Frozen Custard Treats at Andy’s

Andy’s Frozen Custard is known for pushing the boundaries of creativity with their treats. While their classic offerings are delicious, the specialty items add a unique twist. Here are a few customer favorites:

Jackhammer

The Jackhammer is a signature treat at Andy’s that combines a frozen custard base with a delicious filling of hot fudge or peanut butter. It’s a treat that will definitely satisfy your sweet tooth.

Item Price
Jackhammer (Peanut Butter or Hot Fudge) $6.99

Stolen Brownie Sundae

For those who enjoy rich, decadent desserts, the Stolen Brownie Sundae is a must-try. Featuring a homemade brownie covered in hot fudge and topped with vanilla frozen custard, it’s a dessert you’ll want to indulge in.

Item Price
Stolen Brownie Sundae $6.99

The Original Straw-Ana

For a fruity twist, the Original Straw-Ana features the perfect balance of strawberry and banana, blended with vanilla custard for a refreshing yet creamy dessert.

Item Price
Original Straw-Ana $5.49

Customizing Your Frozen Custard at Andy’s

One of the best features of Andy’s menu is the ability to customize your frozen custard treat. From choosing between vanilla and chocolate frozen custard to adding a variety of toppings like brownie, pecan, and even heath® bar, the possibilities are endless.

Here are some popular toppings and add-ins:

Topping/Addition Price
Hot Fudge $0.99
Caramel $0.99
Roasted Pecans $1.29
Banana $1.29
Brownie $1.49
Peanut Butter Cup $1.49

Locations and Ordering at Andy’s Frozen Custard

Andy’s Frozen Custard has locations across the country, so no matter where you are, there’s likely an Andy’s near you. To find the nearest location, simply use their website’s store locator tool.

Ordering Online

Andy’s also offers delivery through services like Uber Eats, so you can have your favorite frozen custard delivered right to your door. Simply visit the website or app, enter your address, and select your favorite items from the full menu.

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)

What is the difference between ice cream and frozen custard?

Frozen custard is smoother, creamier, and denser than ice cream due to the inclusion of egg yolks in the mix. It is also served at a slightly higher temperature, making it more rich and flavorful.

Are there any seasonal flavors at Andy’s?

Yes! Andy’s regularly introduces seasonal flavors, including variations like pumpkin, key lime, and strawberry, depending on the time of year.

Can I customize my frozen custard treat?

Absolutely! You can customize your treat with a variety of toppings such as hot fudge, brownie, pecans, and more. You can also choose between vanilla and chocolate frozen custard for your base.

Does Andy’s offer delivery?

Yes, Andy’s offers delivery through services like Uber Eats in select locations. Simply enter your delivery address, browse the menu, and get your treats delivered to your door.
